_about: Myers diff: the pure model, public contracts, clients, and private implementation.
title: Myers diff
summary: `Vox_diff.diff equal old fresh` computes a generic diff with the right source and target and minimum insertion/deletion cost. Read the pure definitions and operation contracts first; the frontier and its proofs are private.

stops.title: A diff and its meaning
stops.text: A diff is a list of `Keep`, `Delete`, and `Insert`. `source` collects kept and deleted elements; `target` collects kept and inserted elements. `cost` counts insertions and deletions. These direct definitions are the pure model.

stops.title: The returned optimality proof
stops.text: The result pairs `edits` with an erased proof that every diff with the same endpoints costs at least as much. The proof field refers to the earlier `edits` field. No distance recurrence appears in this specification.

stops.title: Operation contracts
stops.to: && target inverse === source edits && cost inverse = cost edits}
stops.text: `diff` takes equality and two input lists. Its result has the right source and target; the result carries an erased `optimality` proof that no competing diff with those endpoints costs less. `apply` succeeds exactly on the source; `invert` swaps source and target and preserves cost.

stops.title: A generic verified client
stops.text: The client calls `diff` normally and calls the result’s erased `optimality` field to compare against an arbitrary competing diff. It also checks forward and backward application. These proof calls are erased: the boundary test verifies one runtime call to `diff`.

stops.title: A rejected claim
stops.text: Deleting and reinserting the same element costs two; keeping it costs zero. The claimed cost comparison is therefore rejected. The same file rejects a cost comparison without matching endpoints, a wrong patch result, a dishonest element comparison, and private helper access.

stops.title: Inside the implementation
stops.text: Private frontier entries hold a position, remaining input lists, and a reverse diff. The invariant connects this implementation state to the pure source, target, and cost. It is hidden by `vox_diff.mli`.

stops.title: Termination without a runtime counter
stops.text: The frontier always has a candidate within the remaining ghost budget. An unfinished frontier has positive budget; advancing decreases it. The lower-bound proof later establishes that the returned cost is exactly minimum cost.

stops.title: Proof erasure
stops.text: The bytecode and native Lambda audits check the algorithm call graph, including the supplied `equal` callback. Metric and proof computations must be absent. `reverse_into` is the reconstruction routine allowed from the private helper module.
